description: Run custom JavaScript against the incoming items to transform, filter, or generate data.

mode.description: "runOnceForAllItems": code runs once with access to all incoming items via $input.all(); return an array of objects, one per output item. "runOnceForEachItem": code runs once per incoming item with $json/item bound to that item; return a single object, or null/false to drop the item.

code.default:
// Returns the previous node's items unchanged.
return $input.all();
code.description: JavaScript source. Available globals: $input.all() / $input.item / $input.first() / $input.last(), $json (current item's data), $('nodeId').item.json / $('nodeId').all(), $now.
